title: Annotatio V §.IV cont.: Lutheran exception — Oral supernatural by mode/union, not by the natural mouth-organ
pass_a_gloss: It is EXCEPTED: that the Oral Eating of the body is and is called supernatural and heavenly, not in respect of the organ, or mouth, which is altogether natural, but in respect of the mode of eating, and especially by reason of the Foundation of the Sacramental Union. §. IX.
pass_b_english: §.IV cont.: Lutheran exception (§. IX) — Oral eating is called supernatural and heavenly not because of the mouth-organ (which is natural), but because of the mode of eating, especially the foundation of sacramental union.
source_text: EXCIPITUR: Manducationem Oralem corporis esse dicique supernaturalem & cælestem, non respectu organi, seu oris, quod omnino naturale sit, sed respectu modi manducandi, imprimis vero ratione Fundamenti Unionis Sacramentalis. §. IX.

lemmas.latin: non respectu organi … sed respectu modi
lemmas.gloss: not in respect of the organ … but of the mode

notes: Exception: Oral supernatural by mode/union not organ.
